m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Now, use the True Essence on the Mutation Chamber. And watch.
<ITALICS>You take the True Essence you collected and add it to the Mutation Chamber. It is almost, but not quite, thoroughly unpleasant. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>There's a crackle of power that feels like Life and Myth and Shadow all intertwined and then... </ITALICS>
Hush, little Bee. You are free of the Shadow Web. Return to your Queen and be at peace.
Hrum. Morganthe's tendrils run deep. I was afraid I might not be able to pull that off.
With your heart and my wisdom, Wizard, we may be able to shake the foundations of the Shadow Palace and the Umbra Legion.
Wizard, duel the Savage Goliaths. But do not hurt them too badly. We need to recover some of their True Essence.
You are here to stop the Shadow Queen. Hrum. Good. I will help you. I know the old ways and lost secrets of the Hive. Hrum.
You see? Old Captain Coleridge did not steer you wrong! I told you we had to go down as far as we could go...
Before we can go up. And up we shall go. Hrum. Captain, lead on.
Follow the Captain's lead. He knows where to take us.
